records.question: Which product category generated the most revenue?

SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS category
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.question: What share of revenue comes from customers who ordered more than once?

  SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_unique_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

FROM order_items oi
JOIN order_customer oc ON oi.order_id = oc.order_id;

records.question: What was the month-on-month revenue growth rate through 2017?
records.raw:
```sql
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
         SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
),
growth AS (
  SELECT month,
         revenue,
         LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_revenue,
         (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS growth_rate
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT month, growth_rate
FROM growth
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM month) = 2017
ORDER BY month;
```

records.question: In which month did the most customers place their first ever order?
records.raw:
WITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_ts
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', first_order_ts) AS month
FROM first_orders
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, month ASC
LIMIT 1;
